front.title: Namespaces for the Robots Exclusion Protocol

abstract.t: This document updates RFC 9309, the Robots Exclusion Protocol, so that a _selector_ (User-Agent: line) in a robots.txt group can carry a _label_ that is optionally qualified by a _namespace_. The product tokens of that standard are described here as unqualified labels; labels qualified by a namespace are written __<namespace>_<label>. It reserves the sequence __ for that purpose, establishes a registry of namespaces, and specifies how namespaced labels are matched. It also defines terminology for existing parts of robots.txt files. Existing robots.txt files are interpreted as before, and deployed parsers ignore namespaced labels.
